decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extension, due to its scale, position and excessive combined depth, would harm neighbours' living conditions by reason of enclosure, loss of light and loss of outlook, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The proposed extension, by reason of its appearance, position and excessive combined depth, would be unsympathetic to the character of the existing house, and the pattern of development in the area. The proposal would thereby result in harm to the Cranford Village Conservation Area contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension to existing rear extension to house within Cranford Village Conservation Area
